title: JasperColumbia Icefield,Bow,Peyto Lake from Calgary,Canmore,Banff
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
A full day of adventure awaits as you explore the stunning Jasper National Park. Journey through breathtaking landscapes including the iconic Columbia Icefield, where you can walk on the glacier and experience the thrilling Skywalk. Discover Crowfoot Glacier, Bow Lake, and the mesmerizing Peyto Lake, offering unique views of the Canadian Rockies. Marvel at the majestic Weeping Wall and take in the natural beauty of Saskatchewan Crossing. Ideal for nature lovers and photography, this tour immerses you in Canada’s wild landscapes.

- Full-day guided tour from Calgary, Canmore, and Banff
- Visit highlights like Columbia Icefield, Bow Lake, and Peyto Lake
- Experience the Skywalk with stunning views of the surrounding area

Columbia icefield and skywalk activities tickets are needed to be purchased separately.Also as Columbia Icefields stays closed from 14 Oct to 2 May due to winter conditions for that we provide alternative stops at lake louise for 45 min and johnston canyon for 60 min.
